history.feedback:
- scene 1: score 2/10. Problems: Objects are vague untextured primitives (white blob and grey block). No recognisable bullet train or guideway structure. The levitation gap is barely visible or non-existent. Framing is okay but the subject is not identifiable.. Fix: Replace with detailed 3D models of a streamlined maglev car and a concrete/steel guideway. Ensure a clear, visible air gap between the vehicle underside and the track.
- scene 2: score 1/10. Problems: Fails completely to show internal superconducting magnets or cryogenic markings. It is the same generic white block as Scene 1 with no cutaway or internal detail.. Fix: Create a cutaway or transparent view of the train undercarriage. Show blocky magnet assemblies with blue frost or liquid helium indicators and labels.
- scene 3: score 1/10. Problems: No visualization of energizing, persistent current, or magnetic field strength. Just the same abstract blocks on a black background.. Fix: Add glowing electromagnetic field lines, flux arrows, or energy pulses around the magnet areas to indicate high current and field strength.
- scene 4: score 2/10. Problems: Red lines are slapped onto vague boxes without representing aluminum coils or a mirror field. No guideway wall structure is visible. Not realistic.. Fix: Model the guideway with visible coil windings or slots. Animate induced field lines flowing along the guideway surface in sync with the train position.
- scene 5: score 2/10. Problems: No repulsive force or flux visualization. The vehicle is not clearly moving away. It remains a vague white shape hovering near a grey block.. Fix: Show the train clearly separated from the guideway with magnetic flux lines arcing between them. Use arrows to indicate upward repulsive force.
- scene 6: score 3/10. Problems: Shows a gap between vehicle and track, but both are still crude untextured blocks. No sense of speed, acceleration, or a recognisable full vehicle.. Fix: Use a detailed train model with motion blur or speed lines. Show the full vehicle traveling along a long, textured guideway with zero contact.
